subject: Spelling (#68)
reason: The change is a spelling-only PR: it edits CI step names, README/QUICK_START prose, code comments, Python test comments and an assertion message, and the wording of one internal log-warning string. The only code change is renaming the internal Rust constant BLOOM_DEFRAG_DEAFULT to BLOOM_DEFRAG_DEFAULT; the user-visible config name bloom-defrag-enabled and its default value are unchanged. No command reply, config, RDB, or replication behaviour changes, so there is nothing a scenario could observe differing between the two builds.
